rss.title: What Survives at 10,928 m? Deep-Sea Pressure in 3D
rss.desc:
A multilayer capsule descends toward 10,928 m in this 3D animation of deep-sea water pressure. The PET shell deforms, the aluminum layer buckles, and the glass cracks. The titanium core reaches the seabed, and a close-up of its porthole takes us back to the start. The depths and failure points are part of the fictional scenario.

rss.title: How Many Paper Folds Would Reach the Moon?
rss.desc:
Imagine folding a 0.1 mm sheet in half again and again. Its thickness doubles each time. At 42 folds it reaches past the Moon. How far would 103 take it?
